# 🇫🇷🔥 District2France | French RP 

🏙️ **Welcome to Quartier2France !** 🇫🇷 

Dive into a **French RP universe inspired by the neighborhoods of Marseille**, where each player can create their own character and write their own story. 🎮 

🤝 **ALLiances & RIVALRIES** 
Join a city, form alliances with other groups, or defend your territory against your rivals. ⚔️🏘️ 

👮 **CHOSE YOUR CAREER** 
🚔 National Police 
⚡ BAC 
🛡️ BRI
🚕 And many more jobs to come! 

💰 **EARN MONEY** 
Work, develop your business, buy vehicles, and build your wealth. 🚗🏠💶 

🕶️ **Risky Activities** 
For players who want to take risks, certain clandestine activities are available. However, be careful: law enforcement agencies can investigate, intervene, and arrest the involved players. 🚨👮
